snippet.title: Resonant Q Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Introducing Resonant Q — our sci-fi action survival game’s first public reveal.
You step into the role of a Volt, a veteran warrior climbing space elevators to reach a crumbling Orbital Ring. Inside this massive derelict megastructure, you’ll scavenge, endure hostile encounters, and uncover the mysteries woven through its corridors.

There's more to show soon so we hope you’ll join us as we unveil more of the game and it's universe.

Steam Page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4097280/Resonant_Q/
Official Website: https://www.resonantq.com/
Discord: https://discord.gg/qbXR2R47s5
Reddit: https://www.reddit.com/r/playresonantq
